instruction: A modern streetlight: a tall tapered pole on a base, a curved or straight mounting arm near the top, a rectangular LED luminaire head at the end, and a small access-panel door near the base. Slim contemporary form, grey metal.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a modern streetlight. A modern streetlight: a tall tapered pole on a base, a curved or straight mounting arm near the top, a rectangular LED luminaire head at the end, and a small access-panel door near the base. Slim contemporary form, grey metal. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
